sources.snippet: 13.08.2024: Mistral Large v2 is now compatible with mistral-finetune! Download the 123B Instruct here and set model_id_or_path to the downloaded checkpoint dir. Fine-tuning Mistral-Large v2 requires significantly more memory due to a larger model size.
